## Rules

- Complete common snapshot is one atomic unit for common/financing/items/parties. Processor/Action owns use-case transaction; repositories do not open it. Removal strategy must preserve declared revision/event history and respect FKs; no string-key heuristic for renumbering. Incomplete/failed snapshot does not mutate current sets. RAG:— (repo-grounded: `@plan/knowledge/research-01-remediation-architecture.json`, D7).

## Guidance

Start regressions from factories with two items/two parties, then apply one-row and zero-row complete snapshots. Inject exception after one family sync and assert all four families rollback. Add renumber test where position 2 becomes 1 with changed semantic identity; document chosen key behavior in D7 consequences/Completion Notes. Do not manually `INSERT` test data. If consumers require soft-delete rather than delete, record exact evidence and update D7 through superseding D# before implementation.
